name: signed_term_gene
description: Signed term-gene table converted to authoritative GMT gene sets

inputs.name: table_tsv
inputs.description: Tab-delimited table with one row per term-gene association

parameters.name: score_column
parameters.help: Column containing signed or absolute score values

parameters.name: sign_column
parameters.help: Column containing sign values; positive=up, negative=down

parameters.name: emit_mode
parameters.help: GMT emission mode. ternary_matrix_notebook collapses to one ternary sign per term-gene pair before writing Up/Down sets.

parameters.name: gmt_name_separator
parameters.help: Separator between base term name and signed label

parameters.name: gmt_prefer_symbol
parameters.help: Prefer gene_symbol over gene_id in GMT emission

parameters.name: gmt_min_genes
parameters.help: Minimum number of genes required to emit a set

parameters.name: emit_small_gene_sets
parameters.help: If true, emit sets smaller than gmt_min_genes
